dose.text: In Part 1, single ascending intranasal doses were investigatedinadouble-blindfashion.Participantswererandomized to merotocin (n = 6 per cohort: 5, 15, 50, 100, 200, 300, and400 μg) orplacebo(n=2percohort).For each dose in the ascending panel, only 1 participant received merotocin initially (sentinel dosing), to observe for possible AEs, before dosing the remaining participantsatthatdoselevelinthemerotocingroup.ASafety
Participants were randomized to merotocin (n = 6 per cohort; 50, 200, and 400 μg) or placebo (n = 2 per cohort).

In Part 2, the participants received 11 intranasal doses, 1 every third hour (and one 6-hour dosing interval overnight) to mimic the frequency of anticipated clinical use for lactation, and blood samples for PK analysis were collected up to 120 minutes after the first, second, and last administrations, and immediately before dosing for the remaining administrations.
Part 3 was an open-label, randomized, 2-period crossover consisting of a single intranasal dose of 400 μg and a single intravenous dose of 20 μg for bioavailability and intravenous PK assessments.
